results.summary_before: This design implements a streaming byte-fed IEEE754 per-operation sequential and combinational accumulation core, generated from an MLIR for-loop pattern. The MLIR flow detects a loop with multiplication and addition and emits a specialized S3FDP accumulator, avoiding generic floating-point logic. The design has a byte-wide input and output interface and requires no external hardware. It is notable for being automatically generated from MLIR and for its use of the S3FDP architecture.

The documentation is brief but indicates a configurable neural network accelerator with a custom instruction set.

results.summary_before: This design implements a two-player secret guessing game in which one player sets a 4-bit secret and the other has five rounds to guess it. Inputs set the secret, start the game, and submit guesses, while outputs report how many digits are correct in position and how many are correct but misplaced. It is a small state-machine design with no external hardware required beyond switches and LEDs for the inputs and outputs. The documentation is brief and contains typos, but the pin names and test steps are sufficient to understand the intended use.
